source.snapshot_note: Shared workload templates, generated offline objects and the common AOT/JIT measurement harness were finalized before sampling; no compiler/runtime behavior changed.

toolchain.cxx:
Fuchsia clang version 23.0.0git (https://llvm.googlesource.com/llvm-project 80743bd43fd5b38fedc503308e7a652e23d3ec93)
Target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: C:\Users\zoy\Documents\Vela\third_party\build_tools\clang\windows-amd64\bin

measurement.aggregation: Median wall nanoseconds per logical operation and sample CV; complete-batch wall time is retained separately. No overhead subtraction.
measurement.steady_timing: Compilation, instantiation, input preparation, verification, warm-up and final forced GC excluded; loop, checks, one Vela host entry per batch and automatic GC remain timed.
measurement.resource_timing: Sixteen source publications, old method-handle invocation and forced GC per sample; includes compilation and publication.
measurement.allocations: Vela Heap allocations including accounted external blocks; C++ allocations are not measured.

suite.identity: Runtime reflection: offline AOT, closed/reloadable JIT, dynamic and hand-registered C++

comparison.reason: This run adds offline AOT and shared source templates, and obtains module filter inputs from nominal type metadata; the previous suite has no AOT samples and uses hard-coded module strings.
comparison.previous_summary_encoding: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=False; sorted keys; separators=(',', ':'); no trailing newline

benchmark_context.luajit_build: upstream amalgamation; default allocator; no FFI workloads

reflection/aot/unused/registered_direct/.operation: registered direct field write and read

reflection/baseline/unused/registered_di.operation: registered direct field write and read

reflection/closed/unused/registered_dire.operation: registered direct field write and read

reflection/optimized/unused/registered_d.operation: registered direct field write and read

reflection/reload/resources/iterations:1.operation: source publication, old-handle invocation and collection

limitations: C++ uses a fixed Counter receiver and one positional integer argument; Vela additionally supports GC, reload, named/default arguments and general runtime type checks.
AOT uses production offline native objects; closed is closed-program JIT. The steady C++ host-reflection API is outside this suite.
Steady-operation timings are amortized batch costs, not isolated public API-call latency.
Resource publication timings include compilation and collection and must be compared separately.

measurement.aggregation: Median wall nanoseconds per logical operation and sample CV; complete-batch wall time is retained separately. No overhead subtraction.
measurement.steady_timing: Compilation, instantiation, input preparation, verification, warm-up and final forced GC excluded; loop, checks, one Vela host entry per batch and automatic GC remain timed.
measurement.resource_timing: Sixteen source publications, old method-handle invocation and forced GC per sample; includes compilation and publication.
measurement.allocations: Vela Heap allocations including accounted external blocks; C++ allocations are not measured.

limitations: C++ uses a fixed Counter receiver and one positional integer argument; Vela additionally supports GC, reload, named/default arguments and general runtime type checks.
AOT uses production offline native objects; closed is closed-program JIT. The steady C++ host-reflection API is outside this suite.
Steady-operation timings are amortized batch costs, not isolated public API-call latency.
Resource publication timings include compilation and collection and must be compared separately.
No execution-time speedup is claimed; the optimization is reduced retained reflection memory.
